title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: Support for a Blocked CultPass Account
content: Check the customer's verified account status. If the account is blocked, refer the case for human review. Do not promise to remove the block, create reservations, or restore access. The stored blocked flag does not explain why the restriction exists. Preserve the customer's request and verified findings in the handoff without inventing a reason or a response deadline.
tags: account management, blocked account, access, escalation

title: Password Reset Email Has Not Arrived
content: Ask the customer to use 'Forgot Password' on the CultPass login screen and check that they entered their registered email. Suggest checking the spam folder. If the reset message has not arrived, retry after 10 minutes, as described in the login guidance. Persistent reset-email or login problems require human support. Do not claim that support sent an email or confirmed its delivery.
tags: technical issues, password reset, email, login

title: Checking the Current Subscription Status
content: For a question about the customer's own subscription, retrieve the verified subscription record for that customer. Report the stored status and tier as recorded. Subscription status alone does not establish payment history, the next charge, or unused experiences. If the lookup fails, explain that verification could not be completed; do not interpret a technical failure as an absent subscription. Refer unresolved cases for human review.

title: Monthly Allowance and Remaining Experiences
content: Use the verified customer-specific subscription record when discussing its stored monthly allowance. A monthly allowance is not a remaining-use balance. This case does not define a billing-period counting rule that can convert reservations into remaining experiences. Do not subtract reservation counts from the allowance. If the customer's stored quota conflicts with the general subscription guidance, preserve the discrepancy and request human review instead of choosing an unsupported value.

title: Finding and Checking an Existing Reservation
content: Retrieve reservations only for the customer linked to the support case. Use a reservation ID when available, or ask for event title, date, or location to identify the intended booking. If several records match a request for one booking, ask which booking the customer means. Report the verified reservation status and associated event details. Do not claim that a reservation was created, changed, or cancelled by the support assistant.
tags: reservation, booking status, account lookup, clarification

title: Checking an Experience's Date and Location
content: Use the stored experience details to answer questions about an event's date, time, location, description, or premium designation. An experience ID identifies one record; a title, date, or location may match several experiences. Ask for clarification when the intended event is unclear. Report the details actually stored, without inventing a timezone, transport arrangement, accessibility feature, or venue rule that the available information does not establish.
tags: experience information, event date, venue, location

title: Checking Available Places Before Booking
content: Retrieve the intended experience and report its stored available-place count. Available places are a snapshot and do not prove that the customer has a reservation. To make a booking, use the CultPass app, browse the experience catalogue, and tap 'Reserve', following the reservation guidance. The support assistant cannot hold places, increase capacity, or confirm that a booking action occurred. Do not promise availability beyond the verified record.

title: Premium Experiences and Additional Charges
content: Some premium experiences may require an additional fee, which the supplied subscription guidance says is visible in the app during reservation. Check the intended experience's premium designation when the question concerns a particular event. That designation does not establish an exact price or prove that a charge occurred. Direct the customer to the displayed app information for the fee; refer unresolved charge questions to human support without inventing an amount.

title: Refund Requests and Unexplained Charges
content: Refund offers require support-lead approval, as stated in the cancellation guidance. Preserve the customer's refund request or charge concern for human review. The available CultPass records do not include a payment ledger, so subscription or reservation data cannot verify a debit amount, payment failure, or completed refund. Do not promise eligibility, a refund amount, processing time, or that money has been returned.

title: Cancellation and Pause Requests: What Support Can Confirm
content: Customers can manage cancellation or pause through the CultPass app under 'My Account' and 'Manage Plan'. The supplied guidance states that cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing cycle and that pausing preserves user data. The support assistant can explain this guidance and inspect the stored subscription, but cannot execute either change. Requests needing action or verification beyond these records require human review. Do not claim an effective date, completed cancellation, or automatic change without supporting evidence.
